scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:dart && npm run lint:python
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:dart && npm run format:python
scripts.lint:dart: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const check = spawnSync('dart', ['--version'], { stdio: 'ignore', shell: true }); if (check.error || check.status === 127 || (check.status !== 0 && typeof check.status === 'number')) { console.log('Dart SDK not installed. Install Flutter/Dart to enable Dart linting.'); process.exit(0); } const result = spawnSync('dart', ['analyze', 'app/flutter_app'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(result.status ?? 0);"
scripts.format:dart: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const check = spawnSync('dart', ['--version'], { stdio: 'ignore', shell: true }); if (check.error || check.status === 127 || (check.status !== 0 && typeof check.status === 'number')) { console.log('Dart SDK not installed. Install Flutter/Dart to enable Dart formatting.'); process.exit(0); } const result = spawnSync('dart', ['format', 'app/flutter_app'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(result.status ?? 0);"
scripts.lint:python: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const check = spawnSync('python', ['-c', 'import importlib.util, sys; sys.exit(0 if importlib.util.find_spec("ruff") else 1)'], { stdio: 'ignore', shell: true }); if (check.error || check.status === 1) { console.log('ruff is not installed. Run: python -m pip install ruff'); process.exit(0); } const result = spawnSync('python', ['-m', 'ruff', 'check', 'ml-service'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(result.status ?? 0);"
scripts.format:python: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const hasRuff = spawnSync('python', ['-c', 'import importlib.util, sys; sys.exit(0 if importlib.util.find_spec("ruff") else 1)'], { stdio: 'ignore', shell: true }); const hasBlack = spawnSync('python', ['-c', 'import importlib.util, sys; sys.exit(0 if importlib.util.find_spec("black") else 1)'], { stdio: 'ignore', shell: true }); if (hasRuff.status !== 0 || hasBlack.status !== 0) { console.log('Install Python formatting tools with: python -m pip install ruff black'); process.exit(0); } const ruff = spawnSync('python', ['-m', 'ruff', 'format', 'ml-service'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (ruff.status) process.exit(ruff.status); const black = spawnSync('python', ['-m', 'black', 'ml-service'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(black.status ?? 0);"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format -- --check
